name: CROSS_GAP
meaning: room for a wire between two pads: li.3 + li.1 + li.3

name: DIFF_SP
meaning: diffusion to diffusion spacing; half of it is the cell margin

name: DIFF_W
meaning: minimum diffusion width

name: GRID
meaning: manufacturing grid

name: LICON
meaning: contact size

name: LICON_DIFF_ENC
meaning: diffusion enclosure of a contact

name: LICON_DIFF_ENC2
meaning: diffusion enclosure of a contact on two opposite sides

name: LICON_GATE_SP
meaning: diffusion contact to gate spacing (HD 0.15 um devices)

name: LICON_POLY_DIFF_SP
meaning: poly contact to diffusion spacing

name: LICON_POLY_ENC
meaning: poly enclosure of a poly contact

name: LICON_POLY_ENC2
meaning: poly enclosure of a poly contact on two opposite sides

name: LICON_SP
meaning: contact to contact spacing

name: LI_EDGE
meaning: wire centre from the cell edge: li.1/2 + li.3/2, so neighbours keep li.3

name: LI_ENC2
meaning: li1 enclosure of a contact on two opposite sides

name: LI_HIGH
meaning: highest non-rail li1: the rail strip's bottom (2.635) - li.3

name: LI_LOW
meaning: lowest non-rail li1: the rail strip's top (0.085) + li.3

name: LI_SP
meaning: li1 spacing

name: LI_W
meaning: li1 width

name: MCON
meaning: li1 to met1 contact size

name: MET1_END
meaning: met1 enclosure of a contact on two opposite sides

name: MET1_HIGH
meaning: highest met1 wire centre: the rail's bottom (2.48) - m1.2 - half a wire

name: MET1_LOW
meaning: lowest met1 wire centre: the rail's top (0.24) + m1.2 + half a wire

name: MET1_SP
meaning: met1 to met1 spacing

name: MET1_W
meaning: met1 wire: the contact plus 0.03 on each side (ct.4)

name: MIN_DEVICE_W
meaning: narrowest device with a contact: licon.1 + 2 * 0.04

name: NPC_ENC
meaning: npc enclosure of a poly contact

name: PAD_ON
meaning: pad contact 0.05 inside the stripe's edge, overlapping it; the pad then needs only 0.27 of poly

name: PAD_OUT
meaning: pad contact outside its stripe: leaves li.3 + li.1 + li.3 at a splay, as HD's nand3_1

name: POLY_DIFF_SP
meaning: poly (not gate) to diffusion spacing

name: POLY_ENDCAP
meaning: poly extension beyond diffusion (endcap)

name: POLY_SP
meaning: poly to poly spacing

name: POLY_W
meaning: minimum poly width = gate length L

name: SD_EXT
meaning: diffusion extension beyond the gate (source/drain)

name: SEED_N
meaning: first NMOS contact, bottom: diffusion 0.235 + 0.06

name: SEED_N_Y
meaning: the same with li1 over and under it: LI_LOW + 0.08

name: SEED_P
meaning: first PMOS contact, bottom: diffusion 2.485 - 0.06 - licon.1

name: SEED_P_Y
meaning: the same with li1 over and under it: LI_HIGH - 0.08 - licon.1

name: SITE
meaning: placement site width (plan_hd.json)
